- [Run-level pack: Research ecosystem and health systems](https://llmsx.org/tree/parkinson-s-disease-research-ecosystem-and-health-systems-trial-design-regulatory-pathways-registries-global-burden-and-care-access/): Run-level pack covering clinical trial design and endpoints, regulatory pathways at FDA and EMA, patient registries and research participation
- [Clinical trial design: endpoints, enrichment and platform trials in PD](https://llmsx.org/tree/clinical-trial-design-endpoints-enrichment-and-platform-trials-in-pd/): Clinical scales, patient-relevant milestones and carefully defined enrichment strategies serve different purposes
- [Global burden, economic cost and access to PD care](https://llmsx.org/tree/global-burden-economic-cost-and-access-to-pd-care/): WHO describes barriers to medicine access, while studies of African essential medicines lists, Nigerian pharmacies and Middle Eastern physicians examine different aspects of access
- [Patient registries and research participation: PPMI and trial finders](https://llmsx.org/tree/patient-registries-and-research-participation-ppmi-and-trial-finders/): PDBP and the AMP Parkinson’s Disease platform support sharing of research data, and PD GENEration offers genetic testing and counseling
- [Regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) for PD therapies](https://llmsx.org/tree/regulatory-pathways-fda-ema-for-pd-therapies/): Regulatory evidence for Parkinson’s therapies spans medicinal-product guidance, biomarker support and qualification, drug applications and approvals, and device supplements

## Top sources, live-checked 2026-11-27

- [ema.europa.eu/en/documents (4 claims in this run)](https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/scientific-guideline/guideline-clinical-investigation-medicinal-products-treatment-parkinsons-disease_en.pdf-0): The EMA guideline describes milestone-event timing or the proportion reaching a milestone as possible primary endpoints in long-term randomised placebo-controlled disease-progression trials
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12481222 (2 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12481222/): Fothergill-Misbah and colleagues state that inclusion of Parkinson disease medicines in national essential medicines lists provides no guarantee of immediate access
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13380763 (2 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13380763/): The Middle East physician survey reported levodopa availability of 98% among its participating countries
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4910262 (2 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4910262/): McGhee and colleagues warn that an inadequately short wash-out can leave symptomatic carry-over and falsely suggest disease modification
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7347582 (2 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7347582/): Yang and colleagues projected the total economic burden of Parkinson disease in the United States to surpass $79 billion by 2037
- [accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter (2 claims in this run)](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2024/216962Orig1s000ltr.pdf): FDA’s Vyalev approval letter states that AbbVie’s amendment dated August 16, 2024 constituted a complete response to FDA’s June 18, 2024 action letter
- [innovative-ctu.ucl.ac.uk/news/news-stories (2 claims in this run)](https://www.innovative-ctu.ucl.ac.uk/news/news-stories/2026/november-2026/parkinson-s-trial-ejs-act-pd-adds-a-new-treatment-arm/): UCL reports that EJS ACT-PD had opened at 26 NHS sites across the UK, with more than 189 participants already randomised
- [michaeljfox.org/sites/default (2 claims in this run)](https://www.michaeljfox.org/sites/default/files/media/document/Economic%20Burden%20of%20Parkinson%E2%80%99s%20and%20Atypical%20Parkinsonism%20in%20the%20United%20States_0.pdf): The Lewin Group report defines PWPD/AP as people with Parkinson’s disease inclusive of atypical parkinsonism
